source_book: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch.6 Work, Energy and Power, §6.4 Kinetic energy (Eq. 6.7) — table-of-contents scope only, teaching authored from first principles. The atomic concept: a moving body has kinetic energy K = ½mv², measured in joules — proportional to its mass, proportional to the SQUARE of its speed, and never negative. Doubling the speed multiplies the reading by four while doubling the mass only doubles it; reversing the direction of motion leaves the reading unchanged, because squaring the speed removes the sign; and the reading falls to exactly zero when and only when the body is at rest. Does NOT cover what CHANGES kinetic energy (the work-energy theorem, work_energy_theorem), where the energy goes when friction stops a body, potential energy of any kind, conservation, or power. Boundary with work_energy_theorem enforced mechanically: this concept authors not a single force-ledger block anywhere in its field_3d_config, and no reader-facing string contains the word 'work' or a bare symbol W, so the engine's own energy panel self-names 'Energy bars'. Built on the newtons_laws_body field_3d engine with the SEAM K/L/M/N energy layer (docs/loop_runs/ch6_state.md) — the first concept in the fleet to author an energy_layer. Pure configuration, zero renderer edits (0d).

real_world_anchor.primary: A vehicle at speed. Drive at twice the speed and the vehicle has four times the kinetic energy — which is why speed matters far more than it feels like it should.
real_world_anchor.secondary: A hammer driving a nail. Swing the hammer twice as fast and it drives the nail much deeper in one blow, because it has four times the kinetic energy when it lands.

v.name: speed
v.derived: the integrator's own live value; no slider anywhere in this concept writes v directly

formulas.checkpoint_track_coordinate: initial_position_m + (v0 * v0 - v_target * v_target) / (2 * mu_k * g)

constraints: K = 0.5*m*v^2 is never negative: m > 0 and v^2 >= 0 for every real v
K = 0 if and only if v = 0
K is a scalar: it has size but no direction, and K(+v) = K(-v)
at fixed m, doubling v multiplies K by 4; at fixed v, doubling m multiplies K by 2
the friction deceleration a = mu_k * g does not depend on the mass
g = 9.8 m/s^2 (the engine constant NLB_G); every surface in this concept is flat, so there is no gravitational potential energy anywhere and no angle enters any formula

aha_moment.statement: Double the speed and the meter reads four times as much.
aha_moment.visual_confirmation: Two identical 5 kg carts, one at 2 m/s and one at 4 m/s, read 10.0 J and 40.0 J on the two K meters — a near-empty track against a near-full one.

STATE_1.title: A moving cart has kinetic energy

scene_composition.text: the cart crosses the whole floor at a steady 4 m/s, and the HUD row beside it reads v = 4.00 m/s
the K meter at the left edge holds at 40.0 J, near the top of its track
the billboard above the cart reads cart = 5 kg

tts_sentences.text_en: This cart moves at a steady speed, v, of four metres per second.
tts_sentences.text_hi: यह cart एक steady speed v से चल रही है, चार metres per second।

tts_sentences.text_en: The meter on the left reads its kinetic energy, K, in joules.
tts_sentences.text_hi: बाईं ओर का meter इसकी kinetic energy K दिखाता है, joules में।

tts_sentences.text_en: It reads forty joules.
tts_sentences.text_hi: अभी यह चालीस joules पढ़ रहा है।

tts_sentences.text_en: Any moving body has kinetic energy.
tts_sentences.text_hi: कोई भी चलती हुई body में kinetic energy होती है।

STATE_2.title: Twice the speed, four times the energy

scene_composition.text: two identical 5 kg carts run in their own lanes, the fast one pulling further ahead every second
two K meters at the left edge, each captioned with its own cart: slow cart 10.0 J, fast cart 40.0 J — a short stub and a nearly full track
the HUD shows a v row for each cart, 4.00 m/s and 2.00 m/s

tts_sentences.text_en: Both carts have the same mass, five kilograms, and the fast cart moves at twice the speed of the slow cart.
tts_sentences.text_hi: दोनों carts का mass एक ही है, पाँच kilograms, और fast cart की speed slow cart से दोगुनी है।

tts_sentences.text_en: You might expect twice the kinetic energy.
tts_sentences.text_hi: आप शायद दोगुनी kinetic energy की उम्मीद करेंगे।

tts_sentences.text_en: Read the two meters: ten joules and forty joules.
tts_sentences.text_hi: दोनों meters पढ़िए: दस joules और चालीस joules।

tts_sentences.text_en: Four times, because the speed is squared.
tts_sentences.text_hi: चार गुना, क्योंकि speed का square होता है।

misconception_watch.belief: kinetic energy is proportional to speed
misconception_watch.visual_counter: two carts of the same 5 kg mass, one at 2 m/s and one at 4 m/s, released together; their meters read 10.0 J and 40.0 J — four times the reading, not twice, and nearly the full track against a stub
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: the speed is squared, so doubling the speed multiplies the kinetic energy by four

STATE_3.title: Twice the mass, twice the energy

scene_composition.text: the yellow mg arrow under the cart doubles in length as the mass climbs from 2 kg to 4 kg on the billboard
the K meter climbs from 16.0 J to 32.0 J while the mass doubles — a doubling, where the speed state showed a quadrupling
the HUD's v row holds at 4.00 m/s the whole way, and the formula surface reads K = ½mv²

tts_sentences.text_en: Only the mass changes here: two kilograms climbing to four, with the yellow weight arrow doubling too.
tts_sentences.text_hi: यहाँ सिर्फ mass बदल रहा है: दो kilograms से चार तक, और yellow weight arrow भी दोगुना हो जाता है।

tts_sentences.text_en: The speed never changes.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Speed कभी नहीं बदलती।

tts_sentences.text_en: Kinetic energy is one half times mass times speed squared, so the meter doubles, sixteen to thirty-two joules.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Kinetic energy आधा गुना mass गुना speed का square है, इसलिए meter दोगुना हो जाता है — सोलह से बत्तीस joules।

tts_sentences.text_en: Doubling the speed gave four times; doubling the mass gives two.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Speed दोगुनी करने पर चार गुना मिला; mass दोगुना करने पर दो गुना मिलता है।

scene_composition.text: two identical 5 kg carts slide apart at 3 m/s, one to the left and one to the right
two K meters at the left edge read the same number, 22.5 J and 22.5 J, each filling half its track
the formula surface reads K = ½m(−v)² = ½mv², and one HUD v row is negative

tts_sentences.text_en: These two carts have the same mass and the same speed, three metres per second, but they move in opposite directions.
tts_sentences.text_hi: इन दोनों carts का mass और speed एक ही है, तीन metres per second, लेकिन ये उल्टी directions में चल रही हैं।

tts_sentences.text_en: One velocity is negative.
tts_sentences.text_hi: एक velocity negative है।

tts_sentences.text_en: Both meters read twenty-two point five joules.
tts_sentences.text_hi: दोनों meters साढ़े बाईस joules पढ़ रहे हैं।

tts_sentences.text_en: Squaring the speed removes the sign, so kinetic energy is never negative.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Speed का square करने से sign हट जाता है, इसलिए kinetic energy कभी negative नहीं होती।

misconception_watch.belief: reversing the direction of motion reverses the sign of the kinetic energy
misconception_watch.visual_counter: two identical carts at the same 3 m/s in opposite directions; both meters read exactly 22.5 J
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: squaring the speed removes the sign, so kinetic energy is never negative

scene_composition.text: the friction arrow points back against the cart's motion on the rough floor, and the HUD carries an f row in newtons
the K meter falls continuously from 37.5 J and settles on exactly 0.0 J once the cart is at rest
the flag stamps v = 4.00 m/s · K = 24.0 J beneath K = ½mv² on the formula surface, and the stamp holds

tts_sentences.text_en: This floor is rough, so the cart slows down steadily.
tts_sentences.text_hi: यह floor rough है, इसलिए cart धीरे-धीरे slow down होती है।

tts_sentences.text_en: Watch the meter fall as the speed falls.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Speed गिरने के साथ meter को गिरते हुए देखिए।

tts_sentences.text_en: At the flag the cart is moving at four metres per second and the meter reads twenty-four joules, one half times three times sixteen.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Flag पर cart चार metres per second से चल रही है और meter चौबीस joules पढ़ता है — आधा गुना तीन गुना सोलह।

tts_sentences.text_en: The cart stops, and the meter reads zero.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Cart रुक जाती है, और meter शून्य पढ़ता है।

scene_composition.text: two live slider rows: speed v₀ from −5 to 5 m/s, and mass m from 1 to 6 kg
the K meter runs live on an 80 J scale, reading 40.0 J at the opening 5 kg and 4 m/s
the cart runs and wraps forever; set the speed to zero and the meter reads 0.0 J

tts_sentences.text_en: Change the speed and the mass.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Speed और mass बदलिए।

tts_sentences.text_en: Watch the meter.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Meter देखिए।

tts_sentences.text_en: Set the speed to zero and the kinetic energy is zero.
tts_sentences.text_hi: Speed को zero कीजिए और kinetic energy zero हो जाती है।

regeneration_variants.label: A Luggage Trolley Rolling Along a Level Corridor
regeneration_variants.physical_world: A luggage trolley rolls along a smooth level corridor. A second, identical trolley rolls beside it at twice the speed, and a loaded trolley rolls at the same speed as an empty one.
regeneration_variants.same_physics: Identical readings: the same K = ½mv² meter, four times the reading for twice the speed, twice the reading for twice the mass, and exactly zero once a trolley stops.
regeneration_variants.scene_hint: Same flat track and same one- or two-body rig — only the labelled object changes from a cart to a trolley.

regeneration_variants.label: A Puck Sliding Across Ice
regeneration_variants.physical_world: A puck slides across smooth ice at a steady speed, a second puck slides the other way at the same speed, and a third slides onto a rough patch and comes to rest.
regeneration_variants.same_physics: Same scalar reading with no direction and no sign: both pucks read the same joules whichever way they travel, and the reading falls to exactly zero when the rough patch brings one to rest.
regeneration_variants.scene_hint: Same rig, same flat surface — the cart is relabelled a puck and the rough state's floor is the rough patch.

assessment.mastery_definition: A student who has mastered this concept can state that a moving body has kinetic energy K = ½mv² measured in joules; predict that doubling the speed multiplies the kinetic energy by four while doubling the mass only doubles it; compute K for given m and v; explain why kinetic energy is a scalar that can never be negative whatever the direction of motion; and say that kinetic energy is exactly zero when and only when the body is at rest.

questions.stem: A 5 kg cart moves at a steady 4 m/s on a level floor. What is its kinetic energy?

distractor_misconceptions.B: uses mv/2 — halves the mass times the speed instead of squaring the speed
distractor_misconceptions.C: computes mv/2 with the one half applied twice, so the speed is never squared at all
distractor_misconceptions.D: uses mv² and forgets the one half

questions.tested_idea: a moving body has a measurable kinetic energy in joules, K = ½mv²
questions.parallel_form_stem: A 2 kg trolley rolls at a steady 3 m/s along a level corridor. What is its kinetic energy?

questions.stem: Two carts have the same mass. One moves twice as fast as the other. The ratio of their kinetic energies, fast to slow, is

distractor_misconceptions.A: the concept's headline misconception — treats kinetic energy as proportional to speed, the way momentum is
distractor_misconceptions.C: inverts the ratio, giving the faster cart the smaller energy
distractor_misconceptions.D: cubes the speed ratio instead of squaring it

questions.tested_idea: kinetic energy goes as the SQUARE of the speed, so doubling the speed multiplies it by four
questions.parallel_form_stem: Two pucks of equal mass slide across ice, one at 3 m/s and one at 6 m/s. What is the ratio of their kinetic energies, faster to slower?

questions.stem: A cart moving at a fixed 4 m/s has its mass doubled from 2 kg to 4 kg. Its kinetic energy

distractor_misconceptions.A: thinks kinetic energy depends only on the speed
distractor_misconceptions.C: carries the squaring rule across from the speed to the mass — the exact confusion this state exists to break
distractor_misconceptions.D: inverts the proportionality, treating a heavier body as harder to give energy to

questions.tested_idea: kinetic energy is proportional to the mass, so doubling the mass only doubles it
questions.parallel_form_stem: A trolley rolling at a fixed 3 m/s has its load increased so its mass doubles from 5 kg to 10 kg. What happens to its kinetic energy?

questions.stem: A 5 kg cart moves at 3 m/s to the LEFT, so its velocity is −3 m/s. Its kinetic energy is

distractor_misconceptions.A: carries the sign of the velocity into the energy — the exact belief this state confronts
distractor_misconceptions.C: thinks a negative velocity means the body has no kinetic energy
distractor_misconceptions.D: applies the sign and drops the square

questions.tested_idea: kinetic energy is a scalar with no sign: squaring the speed removes the direction
questions.parallel_form_stem: A 2 kg puck slides across ice at 4 m/s in the negative direction, so its velocity is −4 m/s. What is its kinetic energy?

questions.stem: A 3 kg cart is launched at 5 m/s across a rough floor and slides to a stop. At the instant it is moving at 4 m/s, and at the instant it has stopped, its kinetic energy readings are

distractor_misconceptions.A: mis-substitutes into ½mv², multiplying by the launch speed instead of squaring the current speed
distractor_misconceptions.C: believes a stopped body keeps some kinetic energy
distractor_misconceptions.D: reads the launch value as the flag value, shifting every reading one step

questions.tested_idea: kinetic energy tracks the body's own current speed and is exactly zero at rest
questions.parallel_form_stem: A 4 kg trolley is pushed off at 3 m/s and rolls to a stop on a rough floor. What are its kinetic energy readings at the instant it is moving at 2 m/s and at the instant it has stopped?

questions.stem: On the explore screen the speed slider is set to zero while the mass slider stays at 5 kg. The meter reads

distractor_misconceptions.A: reads the mass number as the energy number
distractor_misconceptions.B: applies the one half to the mass alone and ignores the speed
distractor_misconceptions.D: thinks a heavy body at rest still holds kinetic energy

questions.tested_idea: kinetic energy is zero when and only when the speed is zero, whatever the mass
questions.parallel_form_stem: In the same sandbox the mass slider is raised to 6 kg while the speed slider stays at zero. What does the kinetic energy meter read?
